how_it_was_checked: SHA-256 equals the value pinned by unrelated projects (nxp-archive/openil toolchain-external-linaro-aarch64.hash; tiiuae/rpi4-64-sel4-u-boot-build .sha256sum). MD5 30c7a2ef1a268d1231fb441ee832eb6f equals the MD5 in Linaro's own .asc file as kept in tiiuae/rpi4-64-sel4-u-boot-build. xz integrity test passed.

what_it_is: The minimal Ubuntu 24.04 64-bit ARM system the image build scripts start from. The address is a daily build, so the file there changes over time.
how_it_was_checked: SHA-256 equals the entry in Ubuntu's SHA256SUMS file in the same directory on the fetch date. gzip integrity test passed.

what_it_is: Google's device-tree overlay tools (the utils directory of libufdt), which the kernel build script downloads from the master branch. Captured at the commit master pointed to on the fetch date.
how_it_was_checked: No published checksum exists: the server generates this archive on request, so a fresh download of the same commit may have a different SHA-256. gzip integrity test passed.
